script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars, your ruling planet, now forms a square to Pluto in your 6th House, demanding you confront hidden obstacles at work and turn that fiery Aries energy into focused action. Venus glides into a sextile with your Sun in the 10th House, brightening your public image and opening romantic doors. If single, Venus's sextile ignites a magnetic charm that draws Fire signs, and your Fire element sparkles. If taken, expect deeper talks that dissolve misunderstandings. Career and finances shine as the Sun’s trine to Jupiter in your 10th House boosts visibility and a modest raise is on the horizon, rewarding your persistent fire. Avoid charging headlong into conflict; the Mars‑Pluto square can make snap decisions destructive, so pause and breathe before you act. Follow for tomorrow's reading and stay ahead of the celestial currents.
